name: Hilda
bio: A skill-damage-oriented fighter with dual blades and grenade launcher, summoning spinning Dirtexpeller turrets that fire laser beams around her.

skills.name: Pyrolytic Cleaning
skills.desc: Commands all [Dirtexpellers] to continuously revolve around Hilda and fire [Hyperthermal Purgejets], during which the duration timer for all [Light Dirtexpellers] pauses. [Hyperthermal Purgejets] deal Pyro Damage to enemies. Defeating an enemy has a chance to restore Sanity for Hilda.

skills.name: Wholehearted Service
skills.desc: Deals Pyro Damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts [Disarm] on them. For each target hit, summons 1 [Light Dirtexpeller] around Hilda and resets the duration timer for all [Light Dirtexpellers]. Carries 2 [Heavy Dirtexpellers] around. [Heavy Dirtexpellers] and [Light Dirtexpellers] automatically target and shoot nearby enemies once every 3s, dealing Pyro Damage. A maximum of 6 [Light Dirtexpellers] can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Automatic Sanitizing
skills.desc: Carries 2 [Heavy Dirtexpellers] that automatically target and shoot nearby enemies once every 3s, dealing Pyro Damage. When dodging, Hilda reloads her ranged weapon Magazine to maximum and gains [Elegant Anger] for a period of time.

skills.name: Multitasking
skills.desc: [Dirtexpeller] has a chance to fire 1 additional projectile, the probability equals to [30%+20%×Hilda's Ranged Weapon Multishot]. Increases the damage of [Hyperthermal Purgejet] by [30%+20%×Hilda's Ranged Weapon Multishot].

skills.name: Hellforge
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Pyro teammate(s).
